scene: You step off the Bento Express onto the gleaming, bustling station platform.
picture: A flat side-scrolling platform view. Far left, the sleek red Bento Express train doors sit open. Beside it on the left sits a miniature electric train layout. Centre, the moustachioed grandfather in navy apron wheels his plant-filled bicycle. Right stands a wooden bento food stall. Up high, a dancing-figure brass clock ticks.
shown: a winding miniature electric railway on a raised table on the left
a steaming cedar bento stall with hanging banners on the right
a brass clock with mechanical dancing figures ticking up high above
